websiteNote: From 5 pages of their campaign website, including its issues section.

Jobs and the economy.summary: Says they would raise the minimum wage, expand job training, and help local businesses grow.
Jobs and the economy.quote: That means raising the minimum wage, expanding workforce training, cutting taxes for working families, giving local businesses the resources they need to thrive, cutting red tape, and modernizing infrastructure so people can live near where they work and build real futures here.

Taxes and spending.summary: Says they would cut wasteful spending so future generations are not left paying the debt.
Taxes and spending.quote: In the Senate, I will fight to rein in waste, make smart investments in working people, and stop rigging the system so future generations are not stuck with the bill.

Schools and education.summary: Says they would raise pay and benefits for teachers and other school staff.
Schools and education.quote: I will fight for increased pay, better benefits, and real support for teachers, bus drivers, cafeteria workers, paraprofessionals, and staff who keep our schools running.

Health care.summary: Says they would lower prescription drug prices, strengthen the Affordable Care Act, and protect Medicare and Medicaid.
Health care.quote: I will fight to protect our hospitals, lower prescription drug prices, strengthen the Affordable Care Act, protect Medicare and Medicaid, cut red tape, and hold insurance companies accountable.

Public safety.summary: Says they would give local police and first responders more training, staff, and mental health support.
Public safety.quote: Keeping Arkansas safe means supporting local law enforcement and first responders with the training, staffing, mental health support, and strong unions they need to do their jobs safely.

Farming and rural life.summary: Says they would help farmers stay in business by growing a wider mix of products and building local food markets.
Farming and rural life.quote: We need to give farmers more ways to stay in business. That means expanding agricultural diversification and building regional food systems that create new markets close to home.

Immigration.summary: Says they would deport violent criminals and fix the backlog in the legal immigration system.
Immigration.quote: I support deporting violent criminals, and I support reforming and fixing what is a broken, backlogged, and bureaucratic legal immigration system.
Immigration.source: Arkansas PBS U.S. Senate debate, Oct 12, 2026 (automatic captions)

Elections and government.summary: Says they would build a strong constituent services program to help people with federal agencies.
Elections and government.quote: One of the things I'd like to do as your next U.S.senator is have the best constituent services program in the country.
Elections and government.source: Arkansas PBS U.S. Senate debate, Oct 12, 2026 (automatic captions)
